title: McGilchrist: the loop that checks the map
summary: Right-hemisphere experience is re-presented by the left hemisphere in a form that can be used, then must be returned to the right hemisphere to be checked against reality. When that loop breaks, confident models go unchecked and the Emissary usurps the Master: confabulation in split-brain patients, hallucination in AI.
source: Ch03 — Iain McGilchrist on hemispheric architecture
